block.guhs.guhkade_kast_flappy.lore: Right-click to play. One button: flap! Your guhs come over for a game too, Nyeg.
block.guhs.guhkade_kast_pong.lore: Right-click to play. Roll the guh past the Mika! Your guhs come over for a game too, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhkade.winkel.flappy: A real arcade cabinet for your home. A guh with teeny-tiny wings flaps its way between the cheese nibble pillars. One button, that's all! Your guhs play too and keep their own scores. Your first cabinet costs 250 coins, every one after that 150.
gui.guhs.guhkade.winkel.pong: A real arcade cabinet for your home. The ball is a rolling guh, and on the other side a Mika is shoving it back. Your guhs play too and keep their own scores. Your first cabinet costs 250 coins, every one after that 150.
gui.guhs.guhkade.uitleg.flappy: Space, W or click: flap. Don't bump the cheese nibbles, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhkade.uitleg.pong: W and S or the arrow keys: your paddle. Rolling it back = 1 point, past the Mika = 5.
gui.guhs.guhkade.tellen: The cabinet is counting your points...
gui.guhs.guhkade.geen_antwoord: The cabinet isn't answering. Turn it off and on again, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhkade.uit.verslagen: Guhs beaten: %s. They're bound to practice extra, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhkade.uit.gewoon: Not quite your best game. One more go, Nyeg?
gui.guhs.guhkade.guh_tip: Guhs nearby come and play here too. Beat one and it looks glum, then practices extra.
gui.guhs.guhkade.bezet.speler: %s is already at the buttons. Wait a moment, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhkade.bezet.guh: %s is in the middle of a game. Let it finish, Nyeg!
gui.guhs.guhkade.verslagen: You beat %s! It looks a little glum... and is going to practice extra, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhkade.verslagen.weg: You broke %s's score! Just wait until it sees that, Nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhkade.guh.voorbij: %1$s broke your score at %2$s: %3$s points! Nyeg nyeg nyeg.
gui.guhs.guhkade.gids.uitleg: Arcade cabinets for your home from the Guhpixel shop. Every cabinet keeps its own top 5, your guhs' scores included.
gui.guhs.guhkade.gids.tip: Every kind of guh has its own ceiling: a Cloud Guh is an ace at Flappy Guh, a Dachshund Guh at Mika Pong. Tough, but beatable!
subtitles.guhs.guhkade.muntje: Coin drops into the arcade cabinet
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhkade_kast.title: An Arcade Cabinet for Home
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhkade_kast.desc: The &dShopkeeper Guh&r in the Guhpixel lobby sells real &dGuhcade cabinets&r: &6Flappy Guh&r and &6Mika Pong&r. Your first cabinet costs 250 coins, every one after that 150. Buy one and put it down at home: two blocks tall, with a screen that really moves.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhkade_gespeeld.des: Right-click your cabinet and play a game. &6Flappy Guh&r: space, W or click to flap. &6Mika Pong&r: W and S (or the arrow keys) for your paddle. Every cabinet keeps its own top 5, with names.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhkade_flappy_mijlp: Score &610 points&r in Flappy Guh: 10 cheese nibble pillars passed without touching a single one. The pillars keep coming faster, Nyeg!
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhkade_pong_mijlpaa: Score &630 points&r in Mika Pong. Rolling the guh back is 1 point, rolling it past the Mika is 5. Three times past you and the game is over.
ftb.guhs_guhpixel.q.guhkade_guh_verslage: Now and then your tame guhs walk up to a cabinet to play by themselves, and they keep getting better at it (up to their ceiling: that depends on their kind). Get a higher score than a guh on the same cabinet. It looks glum for a moment... and then practices extra.
